messages:
acme_admin: Hi team — trying to finish the POC onboarding. SCIM sync from Okta to Redwood keeps failing with 403 when creating a user. We need Dedicated pool access and SSO working by EOD for the demo. Anyone?

maria_sales: Hey! Sorry for the blocker. Can you paste the SCIM error payload and the IdP you're using (Okta/Azure)?

acme_admin: Okta org. Error in logs: "POST /scim/v2/Users 403 - provisioning denied (external_tenant_restriction)". We did grant the app Admin + SCIM permissions in Okta.

jonathan_se: Thanks — two quick checks: 1) confirm the OAuth token used for SCIM is the SCIM provisioning token from the Console (not a Hosted API key). 2) check SCIM base URL (should be https://api.redwood.ai/scim/<tenant-id>)

acme_admin: We're using the token from the SAML app settings section. How do I tell if it's the SCIM token vs API key?

liam_infra: The tokens look different. SCIM token starts with scim_ and is scoped to provisioning. Hosted API keys start with rwd_api_. If it's not scim_, that's the issue. Also for Dedicated pools, you still need SCIM for user mapping if you're using SAML groups to control access.

acme_admin: It is rwd_api_... ok switching to scim_ token now. Trying cURL:

acme_admin: curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer scim_XXXXXXXX" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @user.json https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users

deploy-bot: SCIM webhook: request received 200 OK (latency 120ms)

acme_admin: Now getting 400: { "detail": "attribute 'active' expected boolean got 'true' (string)" }

jonathan_se: Ok that one is common — Okta sometimes serializes booleans as strings. Update the mapping so 'active' is boolean true/false. Example payload we expect:
{"userName":"jane.doe@acme.com","active":true,"name":{"givenName":"Jane","familyName":"Doe"}}

acme_admin: Changing mappings in Okta admin now. Also question: for Dedicated pool access, do we need a VPC peering before we can test model calls? The sales deck mentioned "reserved capacity".

liam_infra: For Dedicated: yes, if you're on Redwood Private (VPC) we need network peering or a VPN. For Redwood Dedicated (hosted dedicated capacity) you can test model calls over the hosted API without peering — but if you want Private/VPC-only access then peering is mandatory. If you want to demo with our hosted Dedicated nodes, you can proceed now with scim_ token + SAML mapping.

sarah_security: FYI security checklist: if we're going to demo processing of customer data, ensure KMS flag is configured and that audit logs are forwarded to your SIEM. Also we'll need the SAML metadata XML if you want us to validate AssertionConsumerService and NameID format. NameID should be emailAddress.

acme_admin: Sending SAML metadata now. One last weirdness: Okta SAML assertion is sending NameID format urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified — can Redwood accept that or do we need emailAddress?

jonathan_se: We prefer urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress. If Okta cannot change the format, we can map an email claim to the NameID attribute in Okta's Sign On -> Attribute Statements — map user.email to NameID.

maria_sales: I'll coordinate with your AM to confirm the demo time change to 3pm if we clear this. 👍

acme_admin: After switching the active boolean and using scim_ token, SCIM create succeeded 🎉. Next: SAML tweak and then we'll try demo calls to the Dedicated pool.

liam_infra: Great. Action items:
- acme_admin: update Okta NameID mapping to email and confirm
- jonathan_se: pre-warm Dedicated pool for acme-tenant for the 3pm demo
- sarah_security: quick KMS/audit checklist pass

jonathan_se: I'll pre-warm a small instance and share the dedicated endpoint and API key (scoped) in a secure thread. :eyes:

maria_sales: Thanks all — please post updates here. If we hit another blocker ping me directly. :phone:
